description: CRYPTO_SPEC §6.2: checkpoint values_digest subject selection — variables with status = declared (§4.2 layout v2, value not yet set) do not appear in values_digest (2026-08-30). values_digest_hex = lower_hex(SHA-256(LP("maruhi/v1/env-values-digest", v_1, …, v_m))), v_j = LP(variable_id, version, value_sig_hash_hex) (ascending UTF-8 byte order of variable_id, active variables only). The encoder's LP canonical form is already pinned by the values_digests section of chain-entries.json and is invariant — this file pins only the subject-selection rule (chain-entries.json is unchanged — §11)
encoding_reference: the values_digests of chain-entries.json (LP canonical form, ascending byte order, duplicate rejection, decimal stringification of numbers)
selection_rule: Selects values_digest_entries (active only) from variables (the variable set including statement status). An active variable always carries the value coordinates (version / value_sig_hash_hex) of its latest version; declared / deleted carry no value coordinates (the value-distribution requirement for active and "it is legitimate for a declared variable to have no distributed value" — §6.3)

cases.name: declared-excluded
cases.note: values_digest covers only variables with status = active (§6.2). declared (§4.2 layout v2 — no value or version exists) does not appear, and the exclusion of tombstones (deleted) is an existing rule (covered on the manifest side — §4.3). The digest equals that of the set of only the 2 active variables

cases.name: all-declared-empty
cases.note: The values_digest of an environment with only declared variables equals the digest of the empty set (identical to empty-set in chain-entries.json values_digests) — the subject-selection-side pinning of "it is legitimate for a declared variable to have no distributed value" (§6.3)
